name: pmap-evolver
description: PMap.evolver(): stores and removes, KeyError on a missing key, is_dirty(), persistent() snapshots that later writes never change, and an original map that never changes.

actions.erase: e.remove(key), observed as Removed or Missing (KeyError)
actions.inspect: read e, the snapshot and the original map without changing them

mutants.name: remove-keeps-count
mutants.description: remove() takes the entry out but does not decrement the size, so len() overcounts

mutants.name: remove-missing-silent
mutants.description: remove() of a missing key returns quietly instead of raising KeyError

mutants.name: overwrite-in-place
mutants.description: overwriting a key edits the shared bucket list in place, changing the original map and earlier snapshots

mutants.name: rehash-drops-collisions
mutants.description: growing the bucket vector keeps only one key per new bucket, losing colliding keys

mutants.name: persistent-forgets-result
mutants.description: persistent() does not keep the map it built, so a later call with no new writes returns the original map

limits: Keys 0, 1, 2 and 4, values 0-2, starting from {0: 0} in a two-bucket map, at most 10 steps per sampled history.
One evolver per history; evolvers made from the snapshot, and PVector and PSet evolvers, are not modeled.
Single-threaded; the driver's projection of the evolver over keys 0-7 is trusted.
